C0579.title: Lianyungang Click Farming Case: Two Convicted of False Advertising
C0579.summary: In March 2025, the Lianyungang Lianyun District Court in Jiangsu concluded a click farming case. The defendants, including Chen, provided click farming services for merchants through online platforms, organizing fake transactions and positive reviews. The court convicted two defendants of false advertising, sentencing them to imprisonment and fines.

references.title: Two sentenced for 'brushing positive reviews' for merchants
